judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a red, sporty car with a body, wheels, and windows.
Draw a distinct circular hoop that is completely surrounded by jagged, irregular flames colored with reds, oranges, and yellows.
Include a take-off ramp on the left side of the fiery ring and a landing ramp on the right side.
requirements.note: The take-off ramp on the left is drawn, but there is no landing ramp on the right of the fiery ring. The pale blue-grey bar at the right (x 1085-1250, y ~490) is not a ramp: it is a flat floating gantry with two lamp dots hanging under it, 140 px above the ground line, and an identical one is mirrored on the left of the canvas.

requirements.text: Position the car in mid-air, with its front half having passed through the ring and its back half still inside the ring.
requirements.note: Nothing has passed through the ring. Against the hoop's fitted mid-band (centre 972,413, r=263), 0.0% of the car's red body is beyond the ring on the forward side; 36.0% is inside the opening and the remaining 64.0% is still outside behind it, so the car is short of the ring rather than straddling it.

requirements.text: The car's rear wheels must be depicted as just having left the edge of the take-off ramp.
Add a ground surface below the entire jump setup.
Incorporate gray speed lines trailing behind the car to convey high speed.
requirements.note: No gray speed lines trailing behind the car. The pale strokes behind the rear wheel are the ramp's own outline: each one runs unbroken from the grey-outlined base plate at the far left, horizontally along the ground, through the bend at the ramp's foot and up the incline to the wheel, which is the ramp structure and its rail, not streaks in the air behind the car.

requirements.text: Add orange sparks where the car's tires last touched the take-off ramp.
requirements.note: No sparks at the ramp lip. A 4x crop of the point where the rear tyre meets the ramp's top edge shows only dark ramp face and sky; the one orange stroke in the scene is a stripe painted inside the ramp's base plate at the far left, on the ground about 600 px from the lip.
